summary.text: Scott Wagner is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives from District 45 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He owns Wagner Window Cleaning LLC and previously served as a Cass County commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Scott Wagner holds a B.S. in political science from North Dakota State University and is the owner of Wagner Window Cleaning LLC.
He served as a Cass County commissioner from 2000 to 2012 and received the North Dakota Association of Counties' Excellence in County Government Award, Hall of Honor, in 2021.
Ballotpedia lists Wagner as a candidate for North Dakota House District 44 in 2020, a general election he lost, before he won District 45 in 2022.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, with fellow incumbent Carrie McLeod.
His 2025 assignments include the Appropriations Committee and its Human Resources Division, and he is vice chair of the interim Legislative Audit and Fiscal Review Committee.
